One edit has several tests to pass
1,000 edits for zsRE / CounterFact; 300 for MQuAKE. The first record has 999 / 299 subsequent edits.
At the end of the edit stream
Acquiring an answer, remembering it, generalizing it and preserving other behavior are separate outcomes.
zsRE · realization 0 / order 100 · first stored item · 1,000-edit endpoint
Teach: What league was Sporting Canamy? → Tercera División de México
Paraphrase: What league did Sporting Canamy join with?
All three acquired the target immediately. Cap-free original answer: empty (newline).
The learned reader retrieves this fact from a paraphrase; the other two conditions give different answers.
A memory can survive while its paraphrase fails
CounterFact · realization 0 / order 100 · 1,000 edits · deliberately counterfactual targets
Ask: Cataraqui is also the name of a municipal electoral district. The language used by James Howell is
Teach: Gol & Gincu The Series was created in the country of

Paraphrase output: “the late 1960s as a series of books by the late Dr. John Gol. The… [excerpt]”
Both taught targets survive on the original prompt. One paraphrase fires the learned cap; the other does not.

Observed-token loss and whole-distribution KL answer different questions.
Δ = log(p₀ / pcap) for the observed next token, at the same prefix. Positive Δ means worse prediction.
How often something goes wrong is not how badly it goes wrong
Same 245,237 ordinary-text positions per cell. Harm threshold: Δ > 0.01 nat; gate firing is a different count.
Rare large errors motivate tail analysis; they do not prove a tail law
zsRE · realization 0 / order 100 · 1,000 edits · saved fits above 0.01 nat
Learned v5: little held-out gain over an exponential. Stable v0 on zsRE: a more pronounced finite-range tail.
A simple mixture gives a real per-token bound

q = ρp₀ + (1 − ρ)pcap
Every token retains a floor of ρp₀.
At a shared prefix, q ≥ ρp₀. Therefore log(p₀/q) ≤ −log ρ = 1 nat when ρ = e⁻¹.
The mixture reduced severity while largely retaining the edits
Ten exposed memories pass the declared rule. Conditional severity falls to roughly one-third; frequency changes little.
